en_title: Marvel Announces Ryan Gosling Ghost Rider Movie | Comic Con 2026
cn_title: 漫威官宣瑞恩·高斯林主演《恶灵骑士》电影
subtitle: 高斯林圆梦恶灵骑士

images.caption: 图片来源：迈克尔·巴克纳/《综艺》/Getty Images

paragraphs.en: Marvel has announced a Ghost Rider movie starring Ryan Gosling, directed by Deadpool & Wolverine's Shawn Levy.
paragraphs.cn: 漫威宣布将推出一部由瑞恩·高斯林主演的《恶灵骑士》电影，导演是执导过《死侍与金刚狼》的肖恩·利维。

paragraphs.en: First details of the project were confirmed today at San Diego Comic Con during Marvel's announcement panel in Hall H, where IGN was in attendance. While the film is still a little ways off — it will launch in 2028 — audiences were treated to Gosling and Levy appearing on-stage to discuss the film.
paragraphs.cn: 漫威今日在圣迭戈国际动漫展H厅举行发布会，IGN也到场参加，项目的首批细节由此得到确认。虽然影片距离上映还有一段时间——档期定在2028年——但现场观众见到了高斯林和利维登台畅谈这部电影。

paragraphs.en: The pair previously worked together filming next year's Star Wars: Starfighter. The fact that Disney is keen for them to re-team again so quickly is likely a promising sign for that film.
paragraphs.cn: 两人此前刚刚合作拍摄了明年上映的《星球大战：星际战斗机》。迪士尼这么快就希望他们再度联手，对那部影片来说或许是个积极信号。

paragraphs.en: The Ghost Rider logo has been revealed at #SDCC , alongside the reveal that Shawn Levy is directing, and it's coming in 2028 pic.twitter.com/L73OqdX51P
paragraphs.cn: 《恶灵骑士》的标志已在#SDCC公开，同时确认肖恩·利维将担任导演，影片定于2028年上映。pic.twitter.com/L73OqdX51P

paragraphs.en: Back in March, Ryan Gosling confirmed he'd had discussions with Marvel to play the flame-headed hero Ghost Rider, though said at the time that it was "a complicated situation."
paragraphs.cn: 今年3月，瑞恩·高斯林确认自己曾与漫威商谈出演这位头冒烈焰的英雄恶灵骑士，不过他当时称这是「一个复杂的情况」。

paragraphs.en: Gosling first mentioned his desire to play Marvel's demonic bike rider back in 2022, which Feige responded positively to at the time. "Hey man, if Ryan wants to be Ghost Rider... Gosling's unbelievable," the Marvel Studios president told MTV News. "Ryan is amazing... I'd love to find a place for him in the MCU."
paragraphs.cn: 早在2022年，高斯林就首次表达过出演漫威这位恶魔摩托骑士的愿望，费奇当时也给出了积极回应。这位漫威影业总裁对MTV News表示：「嘿，如果瑞恩想演恶灵骑士……高斯林简直不可思议。瑞恩非常出色……我很愿意在MCU里为他找到一个位置。」

summary: 漫威正式宣布瑞恩·高斯林将主演《恶灵骑士》电影，《死侍与金刚狼》导演肖恩·利维执导，影片计划于2028年上映。
opus_summary: 瑞恩·高斯林终于圆梦恶灵骑士。漫威官宣新片由肖恩·利维执导，定于2028年上映，两人此前刚合作完成《星球大战：星际战斗机》。
